description: North Carolina counties other than Wake and Mecklenburg (Buncombe, Gaston, Iredell, Guilford, Forsyth, Cumberland, Johnston, New Hanover), commercial, industrial and multifamily parcels from the NC OneMap statewide parcel layer (county assessor attributes), one source per county slice. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/nc-onemap-parcels.md. Wake County keeps its own config (nc-wake-parcels.json); Mecklenburg is nc-mecklenburg-assessor.

sources.notes: Buncombe County (FIPS 37021), 134,741 parcels in the layer, source agent 'Buncombe County Assessor', transfdate 2026-05-11. Use codes from the county's Parcel Class Code table (https://gis.buncombenc.gov/buncomap/classcode.htm, read 2026-11-03): 411 APT -> B; the 4xx commercial block -> F1 (not 416 manufactured home parks, 417 camps/RV parks, 438 commercial parking lots, 442 where the table and the layer disagree); 700-710 industrial -> F2. File 2,450,547 bytes, 5,135 rows (publisher's count by these codes: 5,135). Statewide layer 'North Carolina Parcels (Polygons)' (item 1de3d7d828ce4813b838ddf055b40317, FeatureServer layer 1, 5,938,804 parcels for 100 counties on 2026-11-03). The Hub download API builds a CSV for a filtered request; while it builds, the first calls answer HTTP 200 with a small JSON status ('PagingData', not a 202), which the collector archives as a file, so a snapshot is only valid once the archived file is the CSV (the 228-byte status files from the first run were discarded). The URL filters to the county and the use codes its own published table places in the commercial, industrial or multifamily class. Use codes are county-specific: see docs/registry/sources/nc-onemap-parcels.md for the table, the definitions URL and the codes left out. robots.txt: www.nconemap.gov and hub.arcgis.com set Crawl-delay 60 and disallow only /sites/, /admin/, /sessions/, /groups/, /people/, /workspace/; services.nconemap.gov has none (404). Wake County is nc-wake-parcels (own config); Mecklenburg is nc-mecklenburg-assessor.
